item_name: Rothco USS Growler Low Profile Cap
item_short_desc: Show your support for the United States Navy and those who served on the USS Growler with this rugged low profile cap, featuring an embroidered gold insignia on the front panel. This military-styled hat is officially licensed by the United States Navy.
description: Show your support for the United States Navy and those who served on the USS Growler with this rugged low profile cap, featuring an embroidered gold insignia on the front panel. This military-styled hat is officially licensed by the United States Navy. All-Day Comfort: The navy baseball hat helps shield your eyes from the sun’s rays. Whether you are out in the field, camping for the weekend, or strolling around town, the low pro cap offers all-day comfort and a perfect fit. Sturdy Design: Built with 100% brushed cotton twill, the USS Growler Low Profile Cap is not afraid to get down and dirty. The buckram front panels provide the ultimate foundation of a strong and solid design, ensuring the US Navy hat will hold its shape for years to come. One Size Fits Most: Our hats use an adjustable hook & loop closure for a snug fit that is perfect for most head sizes, allowing the cap stays in place while jogging, running, or any outdoor activity. Official USN: Ready up in Rothco’s collection of officially licensed gear, including our collection of t-shirts, hoodies, and headwear. Got You Covered: Keep your head in the game with Rothco’s collection of headwear and accessories. Designed with precision and purpose, our headgear is built to withstand the harshest conditions. Whether you’re tackling the cold in one of our Watch Caps or Balaclavas, or out on a mission in a Boonie Hat or Fatigue Cap, our diverse range of headwear provides unmatched comfort and coverage for everyone from military personnel to outdoor enthusiasts.
